mainEntity.name: What is an anime gacha game?

acceptedAnswer.text: An anime gacha game is a mobile title built around anime-style art, character collection and a lottery-style summon system (gacha). Leading examples include Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Arknights, Blue Archive and Fate/Grand Order.

mainEntity.name: How are gacha games different from normal mobile games?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gacha games monetize through random character banners rather than ads or level packs. They almost always include a pity (guarantee) system, and they ship large story and event updates on a regular schedule — the character roster is the product.

mainEntity.name: Which gacha games are actually worth playing in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: By combined MAU and revenue: Genshin Impact (60M+ MAU), Honkai: Star Rail (30M+), Wuthering Waves (30M+), Zenless Zone Zero (15M+), Goddess of Victory: Nikke (15M+), Blue Archive (10M+), with newcomers Arknights: Endfield, Neverness to Everness and Infinity Nikki climbing fast.

mainEntity.name: How do pity systems work in gacha games?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pity comes in two layers: a hard pity (guaranteed 5-star) and a soft pity (rate ramp before it). Genshin and Star Rail: 90-pull hard pity, soft pity from ~75. Wuthering Waves: 80-pull hard pity, soft from ~65. Arknights: 2% base 6-star rate, soft pity around 50. Nikke: 4% SSR with no hard pity. Knowing your game's pity is the single best budget control.

mainEntity.name: Can free-to-play players keep up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Honkai: Star Rail is widely rated the most F2P-friendly (auto-battle, strong free characters, generous free pulls), Genshin is close behind (Xiangling, Xingqiu and Bennett remain meta-relevant), and Wuthering Waves regenerates stamina faster than most competitors.

mainEntity.name: Is rerolling worth the time in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not for veterans. A full reroll takes roughly 30-90 minutes in Genshin, Star Rail or Wuthering Waves, and 2026 versions hand out enough free pulls that a reroll rarely changes long-term outcomes. If you do reroll, cap it at one or two attempts.

mainEntity.name: How much should I spend per month?

acceptedAnswer.text: The sweet spot is the monthly card plus battle pass (roughly USD $5-15/month), which covers steady pull income. Whaling only pays off if you are chasing a specific limited banner on its final day — the long-term experience gap between F2P and light spenders is much smaller than the gap between light and heavy spenders.

mainEntity.name: How much time does a gacha game take per day?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most dailies run 10-25 minutes: Star Rail is fastest (15-20 minutes with auto-battle), Arknights around 15-20, Genshin around 20-30 including stamina and exploration. Expect extra hours during a new version's first week.

mainEntity.name: Should I play on the global server or the Chinese server?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pick the Chinese server for native-language story, lower latency and local community; pick global for earlier access to some content, international friends and different pricing. Accounts, purchases and friend lists do not transfer between servers, so decide with your friend group before starting.

mainEntity.name: Which gacha games have PC or console versions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Genshin Impact, Honkai: Star Rail, Zenless Zone Zero, Wuthering Waves, Infinity Nikki and Arknights: Endfield all have official PC clients, and Genshin, Star Rail, ZZZ and Wuthering Waves are also on PS5. Progress is shared across devices. ---

mainEntity.name: How does Genshin's pity system work?

mainEntity.name: Should I reroll in Genshin Impact?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually no. Rerolling takes 20-40 minutes of tutorials just to reach Adventure Rank 5-7, and 2026 versions hand out plenty of free wishes through starter events, so saving Primogems for the current limited banner is the better play. If you do reroll, cap it at one or two accounts. Source: Pocket Gamer reroll guide.

mainEntity.name: Is Honkai: Star Rail worth getting into in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How does Star Rail's pity and 50/50 work?

mainEntity.name: Should I reroll in Honkai: Star Rail?

mainEntity.name: Is Zenless Zone Zero worth playing in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How does ZZZ's pity system work?

mainEntity.name: Is Wuthering Waves worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: Is it F2P-friendly, and what does the monthly pass cost?

mainEntity.name: Is Arknights still worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: What are the 6-star rates and pity rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: Base rates are 2% for 6-star and 8% for 5-star. On limited banners the first 6-star after 150 pulls is guaranteed rate-up. (Source: disclosed in-game rates, via GachaWiki)

mainEntity.name: Should new players reroll for a 6-star?

mainEntity.name: Is Arknights: Endfield worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: Is it F2P-friendly, and what should light spenders budget?

mainEntity.name: Is Blue Archive still worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How does Blue Archive's gacha and spark work?

acceptedAnswer.text: One recruit costs 120 Pyroxene (1,200 for ten). The 3-star rate is 3%, doubled to 6% on Fes banners, with the featured student around 0.7%. mainEntity.name: Is Blue Archive free-to-play friendly, and what should I spend monthly?

mainEntity.name: Should Blue Archive beginners reroll, and how should they start?

Then push the main story to unlock the Cafe, Tactical Challenge and Total Assault, finish your dailies, and only commit to the current Fes banner afterwards. *Sources: community beginner guides; GachaWiki Recruitment page*

mainEntity.name: Is Nikke still worth starting in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The idle-shooter loop stays casual yet deep, the story and character art hold up, and dailies take about 15-20 minutes with auto-play. Nikke remained among the top anime gacha titles by monthly active users in 2026, and its 4% SSR rate plus non-expiring mileage tickets treat newcomers well. *Sources: Nikke.gg; BitTopup "NIKKE Banner Budget 2026"*

mainEntity.name: How does Nikke's gacha and pity work?

mainEntity.name: Is Nikke free-to-play friendly, and what should I spend monthly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. An active free player earns roughly 8,000-12,000 Gems a month (about 80 Gems a day), which is 27-40 pulls, and the campaign plus regular events clear without spending. The best paid item is the $4.99 Monthly Pass: 3,300 Gems over 30 days at about $0.45 per pull. USD $5-20 a month is plenty. *Sources: BitTopup 2026 top-up value guide; Prydwen shop rankings; Nikke.gg*

mainEntity.name: Should Nikke beginners reroll?

acceptedAnswer.text: Reroll is worth it. The tutorial takes about 20-30 minutes, after which starter rewards cover roughly 20-30 pulls. Aim for a meta SSR damage dealer or a core support, then stop once you land one. mainEntity.name: Is Fate/Grand Order still worth starting in 2026?

Its story and character writing remain the genre benchmark and the main story is still advancing in 2026, but dailies run 30-40 minutes with no auto-battle. New-player rewards are better than in past years, and clearing the story early banks a large Saint Quartz buffer plus a free 5-star Servant. *Sources: Fandom "Rate-Up SSR Pity System"; community 2026 beginner threads*

mainEntity.name: How does FGO's gacha and pity work?

acceptedAnswer.text: One summon costs 3 Saint Quartz, with a flat 1% SSR Servant rate and the rate-up Servant usually at 0.7-0.8%. The Guaranteed Summon hands you the featured limited SSR on the 330th roll if it has not appeared, costing 990 Saint Quartz. Free and paid Quartz plus Summon Tickets all count, off-banner SSRs do not reset it, but the counter is per banner and expires with it. The permanent story banner is excluded. *Sources: Fandom "Rate-Up SSR Pity System"; GachaWiki Guaranteed Summon (330-roll pity); West Games pity calculator*

mainEntity.name: Is FGO free-to-play friendly, and what should I spend monthly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moderately. A free player banks roughly 1,800-2,200 Saint Quartz plus 120-150 Summon Tickets a year, about 800-900 summons, enough to lock down a few targets. But the expected cost of a rate-up SSR is 116-129 pulls, and the 990-Quartz hard ceiling runs about USD $480, so plan yearly rather than monthly. *Sources: MMO Culture Saint Quartz saving guide; shattered.io FGO pity odds 2026*

mainEntity.name: Should FGO beginners reroll?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can, but the payoff is modest. Finishing the tutorial and prologue gives roughly 10-20 pulls, and picking the right free 5-star support (Waver is the usual pick) matters more than the roll itself. Long term, saving Quartz a year ahead and concentrating on two or three banners beats rerolling. *Sources: r/FGO 2026 beginner discussion; Fandom free 5-star notes*

mainEntity.name: Is Monster Strike still worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: How do Monster Strike's gacha rates and pity work?

mainEntity.name: Is Monster Strike free-to-play friendly, and what does it cost monthly?

A monthly pass plus light top-ups runs about $5–10; whaling adds little.

Pick JP for the newest collabs, global or traditional Chinese for the story.

mainEntity.name: Is Umamusume: Pretty Derby worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: What are Umamusume's gacha rates and pity system?

mainEntity.name: Should new players reroll, and do I need Japanese?

mainEntity.name: Is Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium worth starting in 2026?

mainEntity.name: What are the gacha rates and pity in Exilium?

mainEntity.name: How does Reverse: 1999's pity system work?

mainEntity.name: How free-to-play friendly is Reverse: 1999?

Source: LootBar free-pull breakdown; Hako 2026 beginner guide.

mainEntity.name: Should new players reroll, and how do Insight and Psychubes work?

Source: HostedGG Psychube and Resonance guide; 2026 beginner guides. ---

mainEntity.name: How does Love and Deepspace's pity system work?

Source: Love and Deepspace Wiki (Wish); Shattered.io 2026 odds breakdown.

mainEntity.name: How much does Love and Deepspace cost per month for F2P players?

Source: PityCalculator Love and Deepspace monthly Diamonds (2026); r/LoveAndDeepspace earnings guide.

mainEntity.name: Is Infinity Nikki worth playing in 2026?

Source: Wikipedia Infinity Nikki; Infold Games official announcements; NYX Game Awards 2026.

mainEntity.name: What is Infinity Nikki's pity system?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pity is counted per clothing piece: every 10 Resonances guarantees a 4-star or higher, and every 20 guarantees a 5-star, whose consolidated rate is 6.06%. mainEntity.name: What does "pity" mean in gacha games?
